receiving_transformations.supported_delta: Original API creation contains the whole initial structural document, which is fetched by editor before first key. Candidate API creation contains h.body only, then locator.fill establishes the whole list/verse/prose before keys.
receiving_transformations.limit: All 17 formatting results are still predicted and checked on the real editor. This does not establish the identical loaded-document premise for structural journeys; no claim that loading the structural document is untested elsewhere.

receiving_transformations.supported_delta: Original keyboard.type emits character key events; candidate keyboard.insertText supplies the same continuation text through native text insertion without per-character keydown/keyup. Real structural keys, native undo and toolbar clicks remain actual keyboard/button calls.
receiving_transformations.limit: The original asserted completed source/preview observations are retained. Character-key event coupling is not the same receiving witness; this static difference alone does not show a wrong product result.
